elements.name: log
elements.text:
Linn: Meet me on the hill.
Warden Ossa: New scavenger? Nobody walks the Berms unarmed. I'm Ossa, on West Gate watch. Take the scrap pistol from the ARMS LOCKER under the canopy at my post; the cyan light marks it. Then use the range across the lane.
Warden Ossa: It runs on nano charge, not rounds. Press 7 to draw it.
System: Scrap pistol drawn. Hold right mouse to aim.
Warden Ossa: Those are training targets: three numbered steel plates on hinged stands. Hold right mouse to aim, then left click to fire; F fires from the hip. Knock down all three. The range control raises them for practice after the primer.
Warden Ossa: Movement on the service road. A scrap drone's slipped its cluster. They back off before they dart in, so shoot on the tell.
Field Pack: Salvaged: Scrap Alloy ×1, Nanite Residue ×2, Micro Capacitor ×1
Warden Ossa: The rest of its cluster is nested at the old machine depot, south along the road. Clear it out. Break contact if you're hurt; vitality comes back, and nano refills when you stop firing.
Field Pack: Salvaged: Scrap Alloy ×1, Nanite Residue ×2, Copper Filament ×1
Field Pack: Schematic discovered: Stabilised Pistol Grip.
Field Pack: Salvaged: Damaged Servo ×1, Scrap Alloy ×1, Nanite Residue ×1
Outer Berms: You go down in the dust. A Warden patrol drags you back to the post.
System: Scrap pistol drawn. Hold right mouse to aim.
Field Pack: Salvaged: Damaged Servo ×1, Scrap Alloy ×1, Nanite Residue ×1, Copper Filament ×1
